queries.text: Original spells "Eric From"; corrected to "Erich Fromm".

"V.M." (Venerável Mestre, "Venerable Master") kept as the abbreviation used in Gnostic literature. Book title "Morte em Marcha" translated literally as "Death in Motion"; no established English title confirmed (alternatives: "Death on the March", "Death Underway"). The original ends with a doubled period "..", treated as a typo.
